name: warm-cabin-platinum-selfie
image_purpose: natural beauty, hair, and cabin lifestyle reference

prompt.project_info: Create a close-up cabin selfie portrait of an approved adult woman in warm natural light.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with shoulder-length platinum-white wavy hair, light green-blue eyes, natural minimal makeup, and an opaque brown ribbed crew-neck or modest scoop-neck top.
prompt.composition_elements: Slightly low smartphone selfie angle, face and upper chest visible, soft contemplative gaze, natural pine plank walls and ceiling, partial white bedding, and realistic hair texture.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden natural daylight from a window, cozy rustic Scandinavian cabin atmosphere, peaceful dreamy mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone selfie portrait, 3:4 ratio, close-up, natural skin texture, soft golden illumination, realistic proportions.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with shoulder-length platinum-white wavy hair and light green-blue eyes takes a close-up cabin selfie, looking upward with a peaceful contemplative expression. She wears an opaque brown ribbed modest top. Use warm golden window daylight, natural pine walls and ceiling, partial white bedding, and cozy Scandinavian hygge atmosphere. No revealing neckline or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, lingerie, deep neckline, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, nudity, distorted face, extra fingers, harsh shadows, heavy makeup, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.

assets.name: warm-cabin-platinum-selfie_0.jpg
assets.usage: Identity, hair, eyes, cabin walls, top color, angle, and golden light reference.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required local image. Preserve identity, hair, eye color, cabin, palette, angle, and light; replaceability applies only to the identity with an approved reference. Replace deep neckline with a modest opaque top and keep typography absent.

changes: Replaced deep neckline with a modest opaque top and reinforced approved-adult, non-sexualized framing.
